candidate.applies_to: versus_captured_output and versus_identity_replay comparisons for every layout; identity comparisons are trivially exact against themselves

identity_versus_captured.strict_equivalence_note: enforced via max_abs_error <= atol on the identity-versus-captured comparison, which at rtol=0 is exactly equivalent to zero isclose failures under the strict bound

justification.no_timing_influence: no evaluation timing value was read before freezing this amendment; attempt-01 timing outputs are excluded from all analysis
justification.numerics: bf16 has an 8-bit mantissa; one rounding quantum is < 2^-7 relative. Placement permutation regroups FP8 grouped-GEMM tiles and reorders DeepEP combine summation; floating-point addition is non-associative, so isolated 1-ulp flips are inherent, not errors.
justification.sparsity_cap_rationale: observed worst failure count 6 of 16,613,376 elements (~2^-21.4); cap 2^-16 admits <= 253 elements, still ~2000x below the >= 524,288 elements (fraction >= 2^-5) that any wrong-weight or wrong-route mapping error would corrupt at O(1) relative magnitude

semantics: two-tier torch.isclose gate; tier-1 strictness for identity-versus-captured is never relaxed; tier-2 admits at most isolated one-ulp relative deviations for placement-permuted candidates; any nonfinite value blocks the run

supersedes_for_evaluation_split_only.note: v1 tolerance remains the frozen reference for the capture protocol, calibration campaign, and confirmation campaigns; it is not edited or deleted
